guide.overview:
LDA City is the Lahore Development Authority's own housing scheme, south of Kahna between the Lahore Ring Road and Ferozepur Road. LDA Road — the plan's 300 ft Indus Road — runs east–west through it to Ferozepur Road, crossed by Jhelum Road and Chenab Road.

Sectors

South of Indus Road is the Jinnah Sector, where most of the developed blocks and the first houses are. North of it is the Iqbal Sector, around the villages of Islam Pura and Panju. In the west, towards Khayaban-e-Amin, are the LDA City Naya Pakistan Apartments and the outer blocks.

Parks and landmarks

At the centre of the plan are Fatima Jinnah Park and the Allama Iqbal Sports Complex, with the Quaid-e-Azam Golf Course to their north-west.

Buying in LDA City

LDA City plots are LDA files: check the file's block, balloting and dues with the LDA before you buy. Browse the houses and plots for sale and rent below, and call or WhatsApp the dealer directly.

faqs.a: South of Kahna, between the Lahore Ring Road and Ferozepur Road. LDA Road (Indus Road) runs through it to Ferozepur Road.

faqs.q: What are the sectors of LDA City?
faqs.a: The Jinnah Sector south of Indus Road and the Iqbal Sector north of it, with the apartments and outer blocks in the west.
The Lahore Development Authority (LDA). Its files and balloting are handled by the LDA.

faqs.q: What plot sizes are in LDA City?
faqs.a: 5 and 10 marla and 1 and 2 kanal residential plots, with commercial plots and apartments.
